article.title: Appeal and revision.
article.content:
67CAppeal and revision.

Section 67C  ·  Chapter XIV  ·  page 27 of the Act
The High Court may exercise, so far as may be applicable, all the powers conferred by Chapters XXIX and XXX of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974) on a High Court, as if a Special Court within the local limits of the jurisdiction of the High Court were a Court of Sessions trying cases within the local limits of the jurisdiction of the High Court.]
